materials.name: HSD7(K)
materials.notes: Line-up of the HSD7(K) core and its prepreg (E-glass only). The sheet gives Dk and Df by construction and resin content at 1, 5, 10, 15 and 20 GHz (for example 3.21 and 0.0018 at 1 GHz for 1035 x 1, 69 % resin), which are not stored.
